svg.title: Actual Apixly Media image, edit, video and recovery workflow
svg.desc: Real acceptance outputs: a red cube edited blue, two references combined, and a mountain-lake video frame. A diagram shows how an existing task ID can be resumed and saved without submitting a new generation.
